description: The upstream answers 200 with a body that is not JSON.

exceptions.reason: The old core passes a non-JSON 200 body to the client unchanged with status 200; the new core fails the request with 502 and an upstream error saying the response is malformed. Whether to pass such bodies through is not decided.
